incidents.name: TrustPad LaunchpadLockableStaking reward accounting
incidents.notes: LaunchpadLockableStaking recomputes stakePendingRewards on each stake without clearing what the user already accrued, so the attacker repeated stake/withdraw cycles to multiply the TPAD payout.

sources.ref: onchain review: victim 0xe613c058701c768e0d04d1bf8e6a6dc1a0c6d48a created 2022-07-18T16:52:20Z by 0x8d9322e08f5220f9a98d533d03e61be4bf3141dd, which is not the attack-tx sender 0x1a7b15354e2f6564fcf6960c79542de251ce0dc9; 16 EIP-1967 Upgraded events on the victim before the incident; code age measured from last of 16 upgrade events (onchain).
